youtube.title: Why 144fps feels so much smoother than 60 🎯 #shorts
youtube.description:
At 60 fps a new frame shows every 16.7 ms, at 144 fps every 6.9 ms – more than twice as often. Smaller jumps between frames = smoother aim. But a 60 Hz monitor throws the extra frames away – check your refresh rate in Display settings.

#pcgaming #fps #gamingsetup
